summary: W4 Independent Semantic Seed Retrieval: materialized Implementation Design contracts and frozen acceptance for grag-seed-retrieval only. DT-04 and DT-05 are scoped to observable Element, Relationship, and View semantic seed channels, independent per-channel threshold gates, every qualifying candidate returned, valid zero-result outcomes, ANN performance-only evidence, and no graph closure, traversal expansion, neighborhood closure, or downstream graph-completion behavior.

explicitEntrypoints.controlPoint: Submit an approved implementation-design semantic query whose purpose is W4 independent Element, Relationship, and View seed discovery before any closure stage.
explicitEntrypoints.observationPoint: Observe separate seedsByType.elements, seedsByType.relationships, and seedsByType.views arrays; each channel must be directly discoverable and independently attributed, with no closure, traversalExpansion, or neighborhoodClosure output.

explicitEntrypoints.controlPoint: Run threshold-all semantic seed retrieval across Element, Relationship, and View channels with many-peer, unrelated, and ANN comparison evidence.
explicitEntrypoints.observationPoint: Each channel exposes its own numeric threshold, returnedSeedIds exactly match qualifyingPeerIds, unrelatedForcedHitCount is zero, fixedResultLimit is absent, and annComparison.correctnessRole is performance-only.

criticalNonExplicitTests.name: W4 explicit entrypoint correctness
criticalNonExplicitTests.controlPoint: Inspect the physical DT-04/DT-05 entrypoint plus the handoff frozen-file list.
